name: Riptide Entrancer — "If you do, gain control of …" waits for its toggle
notes: "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, gain control of target creature that player controls." (2026-10-18) Every "if you do" is asked (Conor, 2026-10-11), but a gain of control with no subject of its own was not continuous to the splitter (its test needs a subject before the verb), so it applied with the toggle at No. Found with Grishnákh, Brash Instigator; Confiscation Coup and Thalakos Deceiver changed the same way. Fired and targeted, toggle left at No: Grizzly Bears stays with its owner.
